text:
The net production of ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is 2 ATP from glucose and 3 ATP from glycogen. Glucose yields 4 ATP (from 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate and phosphoenolpyruvate) and costs 2 ATP (hexokinase and PFK-1). Glycogen enters as glucose-1-phosphate, which skips the hexokinase step, so it costs only 1 ATP and nets 3.

CONFIDENCE: 96
